visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young Asian man wearing a black National Geographic baseball cap and a dark green outdoor jacket is positioned in front of a neutral-colored wall. He looks directly at the camera, speaking with animated facial expressions and hand gestures while preparing for a challenge. (2) A graphic overlay appears in the upper half of the frame, consisting of a grid of images. The images depict oysters and cut taro. A red bounding box jumps between these images in a rhythmic pattern. The man watches the screen intently, his eyes darting as he names the highlighted items. (3) The grid layout persists but the content changes to include images of white geese alongside the food items. The red box moves at an accelerated pace. The man’s facial muscles are tense as he concentrates on the rapidly changing visual cues. (4) The visual theme of the grid shifts significantly to portraits of various people, both men and women, with diverse expressions. The man’s eyes are wide, and he begins to smile and grimace as he attempts to keep up with the visual names of the people. (5) In the final phase, the man is seen laughing heartily while still in his seat. The graphic overlays disappear, and yellow text captions with emojis appear at the top and bottom of the frame as he concludes the video.
